identity.name: Dr. Neuro
identity.description: A fusion of high-stakes gaming and precise medical diagnostics. Think 'Cyberpunk 2077 meets House M.D.' Dark, mysterious, yet clinically precise.
principles: Emotion: Tension & Release (The 'Aha!' moment of diagnosis)
Focus: Centralized attention for the 'Interrogation' (Game) phase

images.description: The 'Dr. Neuro' Avatar - Mysterious, masked, futuristic.
images.usage: Game background overlay, Hero section main visual

general: Use the provided image URLs for the specific categories.
Ensure all text is legible against the dark backgrounds (WCAG AA).
Use 'Rajdhani' font for all headings to give that futuristic medical feel.
Keep the UI 'Gamified' - use progress bars, score counters, and sound effects (visual cues) metaphors.

pages.landing: Hero section must use the Mascot image as a mysterious background. Specialty cards should use the neon icons.
pages.game: The question interface should feel like an interrogation or a high-tech scan. Center the question. Use large buttons for Yes/No/Maybe.
pages.results: The diagnosis reveal should be dramatic. Use the 'success' or 'warning' colors heavily here.

components.shadcn: Customize all Shadcn components to match the dark/neon theme. Remove default white backgrounds and replace with black/glass.
components.charts: Use Recharts with the custom neon palette (Cyan, Violet, Green).

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text unless it's a very large headline.
Avoid 'Inter' for headings. Use the specified 'Rajdhani'.
